e1-16.target: bootstrap (a parser given one block as the bootstrap)

repairs: bootstrap payload 138 -> 110 bytes: cbor_payload_len, zero fill after the shorter payload, crc64_payload at its new position, crc64_header

rules.quote: `true` on a parity bootstrap MUST be rejected (Sections 8.4, 11.4)
Both sentences concern a parity tape (Section 11.4): a no-parity bootstrap may record compression.
It MAY omit the scheme record (key 1) and the digest record (key 2). A Reader MUST NOT require those records on it.

A parser given one block as the bootstrap reports a breach of Section 8 as `BootstrapParse`, including a missing magic and a failed CRC, except that a parity bootstrap recording drive compression is `DriveCompressionEnabled`.

decision.order: No rule of Section 8 fails. Key 5 is rejected only on a parity bootstrap, and this one sets the no-parity flag. A no-parity bootstrap may omit the scheme record, and a Reader must not require it. Its digest record (key 2) may be kept. The parser's one exception for recorded compression names a parity bootstrap.
decision.note: The tape identifies itself as written without parity and with compression; Section 16.3's rejection concerns a parity tape.

by_level.a parser given the block: accepted: a no-parity bootstrap may record compression (Sections 8.2 and 16.3)
